description: Header file defining the cbs_encoder_impl class, which implements GSM-7 and UCS-2 encoding for CBS messages, including methods for encoding messages and selecting encoding types.

classes.name: cbs_encoder_impl
classes.description: Implements GSM-7 and UCS-2 encoding for CBS messages, providing methods to encode messages and handle encoding selection.

methods.name: encode_cb_data
methods.description: Encodes a message into CBS data format using specified data coding scheme.

methods.name: select_cbs_encoding
methods.description: Selects encoding type (GSM7 or UCS2) based on data coding scheme.

methods.name: fill_cb_data_gsm7
methods.description: Encodes message using GSM-7 encoding, supporting only printable ASCII characters.

methods.name: fill_cb_data_ucs2
methods.description: Encodes message using UCS-2 encoding, supporting all Unicode code points in the basic multilingual plane.
